name: Shore
summary: Booking and business software for local service businesses (salons, barbers, wellness, coaches): 24/7 online appointments via your website, Google and Instagram, calendar and staff scheduling, client profiles, automated reminders that cut no-shows, plus email marketing and POS. Fixed monthly price with unlimited bookings and no per-booking commission.
best_for: salons, barbers, spas, wellness studios, physical therapists, craftspeople and local retailers that want bookings via Google and Instagram, no-show-reducing reminders, marketing and (optionally) POS in one fixed-price system
skip_if: you just need a simple scheduling link (a Calendly-class tool is lighter) or you run a business without appointments at all
honest_knock: It's built for local appointment businesses in the German-speaking market, and the package split shows it: booking and the till are sold as separate lines, and only All-in-One carries both. Card fees are quoted on your sales rather than published, so the package price is not the whole bill - and the POS is only sold in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed yearly, €59.90 monthly (Booking, up to 5 staff)
pricing.notes: (2026-09-26, list prices re-read unchanged 2026-11-27, read on shore.com/en/pricing and its 'All features compared' page, in euros, excluding VAT, for businesses only) Five packages on two product lines, each with a yearly-billing and a monthly-billing rate a flat EUR 10 apart ('Yearly (Save EUR 120)'). Appointments: Booking EUR 49.90 a month billed yearly or EUR 59.90 monthly, up to 5 staff; Booking + Marketing EUR 69.90 / EUR 79.90, unlimited staff. Till: POS EUR 49.90 / EUR 59.90, up to 5 staff; POS+ EUR 69.90 / EUR 79.90, unlimited staff. Both: All-in-One EUR 119.90 / EUR 129.90, unlimited staff. On 27 November 2026 a 'New Year's Sale' ('up to 40%', for a limited time) had replaced the September 'Oktoberfest Sale' and cuts the first 12 months to EUR 39.90 / 49.90 (Booking and POS), EUR 49.90 / 59.90 (Booking + Marketing and POS+) and EUR 89.90 / 99.90 (All-in-One, whose card also offers a free iPad for the POS instead of a discount); list price applies from month 13. A banner offers 'up to €360 off or a free iPad', valid through November 30. In September the Booking and POS sale price was EUR 29.90 / 39.90. Card-reader fees are no longer published: they are 'based on your sales' and quoted on request. Cloud TSE EUR 9/month, professional website EUR 65/month, branded web app EUR 40/month; more than 10 locations goes to Key Account. Hardware: Shore Complete bundle EUR 1,499, card reader EUR 69, dock EUR 49, stand EUR 199, cash drawer EUR 99, Epson receipt printer EUR 269. The POS is only sold in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. 14-day free trial. Yearly payment carries a 12-month initial term; monthly billing cancels with 14 days' notice to the end of the period.

sessions.what: We used a free All in One trial to set up two services, publish the online booking page and put a test appointment in the calendar, then went through the plan choice up to the checkout button. No card was asked for the trial and we paid nothing.
findings: There is no setup wizard: a progress panel with five tasks sends you to Services, where one sample service waits. We renamed it Test Haircut at 30 EUR and added Test Colour at 60 EUR.
About 1 minute 16 seconds after we started, both services showed on the public booking page, which clients can open without a login and in 12 languages.
A test appointment took about 2 minutes. The client notification switch is on by default, so we turned it off before saving.
Plans read 59.90, 79.90 and 129.90 EUR a month, or 49.90, 69.90 and 119.90 EUR a month yearly. Booking yearly came to an order of 598.80 EUR, and SMS features are charged separately.
We found no button to end the trial or delete the account in the app. The trial ends by itself after 15 days; ending it early is done by email.
not_tested: paying for a plan, the iPad POS till, SMS, online payments at booking and Google or Instagram booking links
booking as a client on the public page, staff management and how reminders cut no shows
